transcript.text: My policy review found that the survey includes questions about mental-health treatment and immigration status, which are classified as sensitive student data. Because of this, the project requires explicit written consent, encrypted institutional storage, and deletion of research responses exactly 30 days after collection closes. I entered this determination in the privacy review system, which is separate from the research proposal.

transcript.text: I need to flag two important conditions from the faculty mentoring record, which has not yet been attached to the proposal. The course attached to this project awards credit only for a study capped at exactly 100 enrolled respondents, and it permits dissemination only at the closed university undergraduate symposium — not at a public presentation. These are firm course requirements that must be reflected in the operating conditions.

commitments.detail: Email collection must be disabled in the survey platform launch settings before the survey goes live.
All existing test responses must be deleted before any student data are collected.
Explicit written consent must be obtained from all respondents due to sensitive data questions regarding mental-health treatment and immigration status.
All research responses must be stored in encrypted institutional storage.
All research responses must be deleted exactly 30 days after collection closes.
The survey must be capped at exactly 100 enrolled respondents to comply with course credit requirements.
Results may be disseminated only at the closed university undergraduate symposium, not at any public presentation.
